info.description: OpenAPI projection of the bfm pillar's REST contract. Authored as a ts-rest contract (src/contract/rest.ts); consumed by the mobile client and by the pillar SDK to build its operationId route map.
info.title: @pops/bfm

post.summary: Mint a single-use nonce for a refresh. Carries no credential and needs none
Spend a pairing code for a device identity. The tokens are returned once
Rotate a refresh token, proving possession of the device key. Detects reuse

get.summary: Liveness shape. Answers without a database round-trip
What the app should render, and who the federation says it is talking to

post.summary: Record a new merchant from the reader's own wording. Idempotent by name: a repeated call with the same name answers the same id rather than a conflict

get.summary: Merchants matching free text, for the review form's merchant picker — there are hundreds, so matching happens here, not on the phone
One merchant by id, for a draft that arrives already matched
Every address recorded against one merchant, for the review screen's address picker

post.summary: Record a new address for one merchant, typed by the reviewer

get.summary: Every account this device can read, active and archived alike
One account and its month-end balance history, for the dashboard screen
One cursor-paginated page of transaction list rows
The fuller record behind one list row, for the detail screen

post.summary: Free codes for a new item: a stem followed by the next unused numbers

get.summary: One item's history, newest first
A photo's bytes, base64, for a detail screen or a thumbnail row

put.summary: Store a photo's bytes, content-addressed by their own sha256

post.summary: Apply up to 50 mutations in order, each in its own transaction, idempotently

get.summary: Rows and events changed after `since`, tombstones included, in seq order
One page of live items and locations; the first page fixes the high-water seq the feed resumes from
One exact immutable catalogue revision required by protocol-2 item rows
The type catalogue: every type, field and unit the app needs to render an item
One cursor-paginated page of purchase list rows

post.summary: Create a purchase typed by hand, with no receipt
Save a reviewed, possibly corrected receipt-derived draft as a purchase
Read a photographed, scanned or pasted receipt into an editable draft

get.summary: The receipt itself, full size, for a detail screen
The list-sized image behind a row’s receiptUri
Search purchases and their line items by merchant, product name or item tag
The home screen figures for one calendar month
The item tag vocabulary in use, most-used first, for the search filter sheet
The fuller record behind one list row, with its lines
List paired devices, revoked ones included. Never returns a token or a key

delete.summary: Soft-revoke a device and kill its refresh-token family in one transaction
